What is an electrical transformer?
An electrical transformer is a static electrical device that transfers electrical energy between circuits through electromagnetic induction. It is commonly used to increase or decrease AC voltage.

What is transformer efficiency?
Transformer efficiency is the ratio of output power to input power, usually expressed as a percentage.

What is dissolved gas analysis?

Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) is a diagnostic technique used to examine gases dissolved in transformer insulating oil. The gas concentrations can help identify developing electrical and thermal faults.

What is hydrogen in transformer oil?

Hydrogen is one of the gases monitored in transformer oil. Increased hydrogen concentration can be associated with partial discharge and other electrical or thermal fault activity. Its interpretation requires analysis of other gases and operating conditions.

What is partial discharge?
Partial discharge is a localized electrical discharge that partially bridges the insulation between conductors. It can indicate insulation deterioration.

Why do transformers need cooling?
Transformers generate heat due to winding resistance and magnetic core losses. Cooling systems remove this heat and help maintain safe operating temperatures.

What is transformer winding temperature?
Winding temperature is the temperature of a transformer's winding conductor or an estimate of its hot-spot temperature. It is important for insulation life and safe operation.

What is a Buchholz relay?

A Buchholz relay is a gas-actuated protective device installed in the pipe between the main tank and conservator of certain oil-filled transformers. It detects gas accumulation and oil surges associated with internal faults.

What is a transformer tap changer?
A tap changer changes the effective turns ratio of a transformer to regulate its output voltage. It can operate while the transformer is energized or only when de-energized, depending on its type.

What is the purpose of transformer oil?
Transformer oil provides electrical insulation and helps transfer heat away from the core and windings. It can also be sampled for diagnostic testing.
